claims.statement: The marked semistable V->X admits a finite (K_V+H_V)-MMP over the birational target X with divisorial contractions/flips, Q-factoriality, nonextraction and the required discrepancy preservation, terminating in a nef model or Mori fiber space.
hypotheses: Smooth projective birational threefold V over the literal log-model target X
Every augmented fiber boundary is SNC initially
Relative base is X, not merely the curve
No stronger target singularity assumption is added
claims.supported_scope: Exact formulation of what the conditional proof requires; starting SNC/dlt and relative-base requirements identified.
claims.version_difference: v2 adds explicit A_KM79_REQUIRED_064; no proof or exact primary source was added.

novelty.explanation: An unverified external theorem application, not an original MMP result or a certified manuscript flaw.

claims.attribution: Manuscript invokes Kollar-Mori (1998), Definition 7.1 and Theorem 7.9. Publisher chapter metadata was obtained; the operative primary passages were not.

external_assumptions.gap: A theorem supplying the exact marked finite relative MMP over X, not only a curve, under the stated target hypotheses.
